content.title: Tilray CEO says THC drink regulation will benefit cannabis companies
content.description:
President Trump is expected to sign an executive order that could reclassify marijuana from a Schedule I to a Schedule III drug, which would enable cannabis to be federally classified for medical use.

Tilray Brands (TLRY) Chairman and CEO Irwin Simon sits down with Julie Hyman to share his outlook on his company's THC and hemp products in relation to Congress' latest budget bill that could see a ban on most hemp-derived THC products by late 2026.

To watch more expert insights and analysis on the latest market action, check out more Market Catalysts.

content.title: Cannabis Stocks Soar on Reports White House Plans to Reclassify Pot
content.summary: Cannabis stocks surged on Friday following reports that President Trump plans to push to ease federal restrictions on marijuana. The White House is expected to direct federal agencies to reclassify cannabis as a less-dangerous drug, according to the Washington Post and Bloomberg News.

content.title: TSX Growth Stocks With High Insider Ownership To Watch
content.summary: As we approach the end of 2025, Canadian markets have experienced impressive double-digit gains, with investors closely monitoring central bank decisions and economic indicators for clues on future trends. In this environment, growth companies with high insider ownership can be particularly appealing as they often demonstrate strong alignment between management and shareholder interests, making them worth watching in a climbing market.
